title: AI Clones Your Voice in 3 Seconds!
full_monologue: What if I told you AI can clone your voice in 3 seconds? I tested it myself, and it’s insane. Just record a short clip, and the AI generates a perfect replica. Think about the possibilities—deepfakes, virtual assistants, even audiobooks. But with power comes responsibility. How do we ensure it’s used ethically? Let me know your thoughts below.
